::: {#def-append}
#### Appending two lists

The **append** $\operatorname{app}(L, M)$ of two lists $L$ and $M$ (@def-list),
the list of the elements of $L$ followed by the elements of $M$,
is defined recursively on $L$:

$$
\ba
\operatorname{app}(\mathtt{empty}, M) &= M,
\\ \operatorname{app}\paren{\operatorname{cons}(x, L), M} &= \operatorname{cons}\paren{x, \operatorname{app}(L, M)}.
\ea
$$

:::
